text: "This looks as if it were delicious, Debby, I wish you'd try it: Take a gallon of oysters, a pint of beef stock, sixteen soda crackers, the juice of two lemons, four cloves, a glass of white wine, a sprig of marjoram, a sprig of thyme, a sprig of bay, a sliced shalott--" "Please, Miss Katy, what's them?" "Oh, don't you know, Debby? It must be something quite common, for it's in almost all the recipes." "No, Miss Katy, I never heard tell of it before. Miss Carr never gave me no shell-outs at all at all!"
